record.one_liner: Hosting and deploy platform for web sites and apps, with a REST API for managing sites and deploys.
record.auth_notes: Personal access tokens sent as a Bearer header; OAuth2 required for public integrations acting on a user's behalf.
record.access_notes: Free plan is listed as free forever and PATs are generated from the user's account settings. The docs do not state a plan gate on API use. critic: access confirmed.
record.api_notes: Breadth is a judgement call. Rate limit is 500 requests per minute for most requests, with stricter limits for deploys.
record.blocker_notes: No review or sales step in the docs; OAuth app registration is self-serve in user settings. critic: verdict confirmed.

evidence.quote: The OAuth2 end-user authorization endpoint is https://app.netlify.com/authorize.
